walks.info: **🐾 Greyt Global Greyhound Walk 2026 🐾** Join the **Gold Coast Greyhound Support Network** as we celebrate the annual **Greyt Global Greyhound Walk** at the beautiful **Gold Coast Regional Botanic Gardens, Ashmore**. This special event brings greyhounds and their people together to celebrate these wonderful dogs while connecting with fellow sighthound lovers in a relaxed and friendly environment. We'll enjoy a leisurely walk along the shaded and sunny loop track through the gardens, with plenty of opportunities for the dogs (and humans!) to socialise. Towards the end of the walk, many of the dogs love cooling off with a splash in the lake before gathering near the dog water taps for a chat and catch-up. **🐕 Who's welcome?** All **sighthound breeds** are warmly welcome, including greyhounds, whippets, Italian greyhounds, salukis, borzois, Afghan hounds and other sighthounds. To help ensure all dogs feel safe and comfortable, we kindly ask that **non-sighthound dogs be medium-sized or larger**. Some of our greyhounds can be triggered by smaller dogs due to their racing backgrounds, and this simple guideline helps make the walk enjoyable for everyone. Thank you for your understanding and support. **Meeting Point:** We'll meet near the **playground and public amenities**, where parking is also available. Please refer to the Facebook event for the exact pin drop location and any updates. https://www.facebook.com/events/4256874221265598/ 💙 **New to the Gold Coast Greyhound Support Network?** We'd love to welcome you to our community! We're a small, friendly and supportive group of greyhound and sighthound owners who enjoy getting together each month for relaxed pack walks, sharing advice, celebrating our dogs and supporting one another. Whether you're a first-time owner or have loved sighthounds for years, you'll always find a warm welcome. Join our Facebook group to stay up to date with future pack walks, events and everything happening in our wonderful greyhound community. https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1LETN2sr55/?mibextid=wwXIfr . We can't wait to see you and your hounds for this year's **Greyt Global Greyhound Walk!** 🐾
